9290.meaning1: in the sense of not being one's possession; in the sense of not being one's own

examples.text: rogato'ti-ādīsu ābādh'aṭṭhena rogato, antodos'aṭṭhena gaṇḍato, anupaviddh'aṭṭhena dukkhajanan'aṭṭhena ca sallato, dukkh'aṭṭhena aghato, rog'aṭṭhena ābādhato, asak'aṭṭhena parato, palujjan'aṭṭhena palokato, nissatt'aṭṭhena suññato, na att'aṭṭhena anattato.

9291.commentary: (THIa) yasmā kāmesu kāmahetu ime sattā vadhabandhanadukkhāni anubhavanti pāpuṇanti, tasmā āha, asakāmā'ti, kāmā nām'ete asanto hīnā lāmakā'ti attho. ahakāmā'ti vā pāṭho, so ev'attho. ahā'ti hi lāmakapariyāyo ahalokitthiyo nāmā'ti-ādīsu viya.

examples.text: mokkhamhi vijjamāne, kiṃ tava kāmehi yesu vadhabandho, kāmesu hi asakāmā, vadhabandhadukhāni anubhonti.
kim'iva pūtikāyam'asuciṃ, savanagandhaṃ bhayānakaṃ kuṇapaṃ, abhisaṃviseyyaṃ bhastaṃ, asakiṃ paggharitaṃ asucipuṇṇaṃ.

9295.grammar: ind, adv, ger of na sakkaroti, comp vb, neg
9295.construction:
na > a + sat + kacca + aṃ
asakkacca + aṃ

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū asakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti chaḍḍetu'kāmā viya

9296.grammar: pp of na sakkaroti, comp, neg
9296.meaning1: not honoured; not esteemed; not respected

examples.text: aññatitthiyā pana paribbājakā asakkatā honti agarukatā amānitā apūjitā anapacitā, na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānaṃ.

9297.grammar: masc, comp, from na sakkaroti, neg

examples.text: yassa sakkariyamānassa, asakkārena c'ūbhayaṃ, samādhi na vikampati, appamādavihārino.
